name: planning-skills-for-agents-and-humans
description: Planning workflows with evidence-gated Lead User research, fluid collaborative shaping, explicit promotion gates, Wayfinding, breadboarding, executable handoffs, context, and reflection.

interface.longDescription: Reusable workflows for product and engineering planning. Start from a rough need, requirements, a proposed solution, evidence, or a focused uncertainty; shape alternatives, breadboard behavior, define bounded implementation handoffs, and check drift. The plugin preserves explicit human gates for appetite, selection, scope, and promotion. Its MCP tools provide read-only routing, canonical skill resources, templates, contracts, and orchestration rules; they do not choose a solution or modify external systems.
defaultPrompt: Help me shape this product idea without choosing the solution for me.
Figure out the smallest planning move this project needs.
Check whether this implementation has drifted from the accepted plan.
